name: parse_dev_env
logic_name: Nix Dev Env Parsing and Safety

test_list.description: Keep only exported scalar strings from the official JSON variables object shape.
Return a typed size error before decoding over-limit input.
Reject JSON without a variables object.
Drop shell setup and secret-like names while preserving PATH.
Represent the flake installable as one positional argument.
Reject control characters in an installable reference.
Reject leading option syntax from the installable input.
Include all three cache key inputs using unambiguous field encoding.
Store and load a sanitized environment through the injected exact cache contract.
Reject a cached host HOME variable on read.
Reject unhashed fetchurl and common host-absolute paths.
Accept a hashed fetchurl in a simple flake expression.
Build the S2 input prompt from bounded manifest content without invoking a model.
Reject source paths that escape the project root.
JSON encode manifest content and reject source path traversal.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: Captured print-dev-env output from an injected sandbox process boundary.

output_description: Bounded exported scalar environment data or a typed parse/security error.
